Free Therapy Tools is an open-source project. Different parts of the project use different licences.

## Educational content

Original educational text, lessons, diagrams, and explanatory figures are licensed under [Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/) (`CC-BY-SA-4.0`).

When reusing this material, give appropriate credit, link to the licence and source, indicate whether changes were made, and share adaptations under CC BY-SA 4.0 or a compatible licence.

Suggested credit:

> Based on material from **Free Therapy Tools** and its contributors. Source: <https://github.com/backgammonsimplified/freetherapytools.github.io>. Licensed under **CC BY-SA 4.0**. Changes were made.
